text: SUPERVISOR — third in your queue (WBSTEP9 -> BUILDSKIN -> this): REQPANEL-0606. User verbatim: "for the request method we have been doing where its recorded, we should get someone to make a simple interface for us from the data. just so i can see what is left unresolved and can click it was resolved or not". A simple workbench surface over the request ledger (docs/game/_requests/ + tools/request, REQUESTS.md): list every request — id, date, origin, the verbatim ask, status — with UNRESOLVED filtered to the top/default view, and a click toggles resolved/unresolved. ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH: the interface drives the SAME machinery as tools/request (resolve semantics — a user-click resolve records "resolved by user via interface" as the para; unresolve if supported, or surface that resolve is one-way if the ledger says so — do not invent a parallel status store). Supervisor dispatches (the marker-tracked ones) stay hidden by default like request list --open does. Keep it SIMPLE — list + filter + click, no dashboard ambitions; the settings/logs source patterns you just built are the kit. Tests at the consumption layer. READY when the user can see what is left and click it done. DO NOT COMMIT.
